title: High-strength NbMoTaX refractory high-entropy alloy with low stacking fault energy eutectic phase via laser additive manufacturing
process_description: prepared by selective laser melting using YLR-500-WC laser with power of 300 W, scan speed of 300 mm/s, layer thickness of 0.03 mm and scan distance of 0.06 mm on preheated Ti alloy substrate at 200°C
